pass.answer: Only a bare-name deny of `Bash` removes the schema.

Only denying the whole Bash tool, with no specifier, takes its schema out, e.g.
```json
{"permissions":{"deny":["Bash"]}}
```
A deny of the tool name alone is what the audit prices.
